# Star Works

> Star Works is a full-service digital agency based in India, specializing in web development, app development, e-commerce, digital marketing, and brand identity. We help startups and businesses worldwide build their digital presence.

## Services
- **Web Development**: Custom websites with Next.js, React, Node.js
- **App Development**: Mobile and web apps for iOS, Android, cross-platform
- **E-Commerce Solutions**: Online stores with Shopify, WooCommerce, custom builds
- **Web Design**: UI/UX design, Figma prototyping, responsive design
- **Digital Marketing**: SEO, content marketing, social media, paid advertising
- **Brand Identity**: Logo design, brand guidelines, visual identity
